allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Ajooni Biotech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 9000000 securities pursuant to Preferential Issue at its meeting held on August 12, 2026

allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Ajooni Biotech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated January 06, 2025, titled "Ajooni Biotech to Offer 5 Crores Convertible Warrants at ₹9 Each, Raising ₹45 Crores from Promoters, Non-Promoters Including Funds and Corporates".
